patch.value:
The replay adapter bypasses the `ambiguous_model` refusal added in PR #99. Against the same conflicting native inventory, direct admission refuses while replay selects whichever equivalent reference appears first and submits inference. Verified on `93c51cb0d51b20b33fcd38dbf76a22bbcdc093f0` with the built package and a synthetic loopback HTTP endpoint; no model or hosted service was used. ### Exact source - [Replay picks the first normalized reference and immediately pins its digest](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-jev/blob/93c51cb0d51b20b33fcd38dbf76a22bbcdc093f0/policy-replay.ts#L219-L229). - [Admission only checks conflicting normalized references when the input is not already digest-addressed](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-jev/blob/93c51cb0d51b20b33fcd38dbf76a22bbcdc093f0/decision-admission.ts#L149-L163). Passing the replay-selected digest makes this gate unreachable for replay. ### Reproduction Node 24.19.0 and lockfile dependencies. The committed `admissionMetadata` helper supplies the pinned template and a small supported byte vocabulary. The loopback server records real requests from the TypeSafe SDK. The second replay reverses only the inventory order. ```sh work=$(mktemp -d) git clone --quiet https://github.com/unbraind/pm-jev.git "$work/package" cd "$work/package" git checkout --quiet 93c51cb0d51b20b33fcd38dbf76a22bbcdc093f0 npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund npm run build cat > repro.mjs <<'EOF' import {createServer} from 'node:http'; import {admitDecision, createOllamaReplayAdapter} from './dist/index.js'; import {admissionMetadata} from './test/admission-fixtures.ts'; const requests=[]; let models=[{name:'tev1:4b',digest:'a'.repeat(64),capabilities:['decision']},{name:'registry.ollama.ai/library/tev1:4b',digest:'b'.repeat(64),capabilities:['decision']}]; const server=createServer(async(req,res)=>{let text='';for await(const chunk of req)text+=chunk;const body=text?JSON.parse(text):{};requests.push({path:req.url,model:body.model});res.setHeader('content-type','application/json');res.end(JSON.stringify(req.url==='/api/tags'?{models}:req.url==='/api/show'?admissionMetadata():{model:body.model,answers:{keep:{type:'noul',noul:0.9}},usage:{input_tokens:1,output_tokens:1}}));}); await new Promise(r=>server.listen(0,'127.0.0.1',r)); try{const baseUrl=`http://127.0.0.1:${server.address().port}`; const config={provider:'ollama',baseUrl,model:'tev1:4b',timeoutMs:10000,totalDeadlineMs:10000}; const questions={keep:{type:'noul'}}; try{await admitDecision(config,'fixture',questions);}catch(e){console.log('direct admission:',e.code);} for(let i=0;i<2;i++){const adapter=await createOllamaReplayAdapter('tev1:4b',baseUrl);const result=await adapter.decide({id:'fixture',state:'fixture',questions,result:{},policy:{version:'v1',min_probability:0.5}}); console.log('replay selected digest:',result.model.slice(7,15));models.reverse();} console.log('inference requests:',requests.filter(r=>r.path==='/v1/systemone').length); }finally{server.closeAllConnections();await new Promise(r=>server.close(r));} EOF PM_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 PM_AGENT_PROBES=0 NODE_ENV=test node repro.mjs ``` Observed output: ```text direct admission: ambiguous_model replay selected digest: aaaaaaaa replay selected digest: bbbbbbbb inference requests: 2 ``` ### Expected / actual Expected: conflicting digests for equivalent native model names refuse before `/api/show` or inference, including through `createOllamaReplayAdapter`. The refusal should explain how to resolve the inventory conflict or explicitly select a verified digest. Actual: direct admission reports `ambiguous_model`, but both replay calls succeed and choose different model digests solely because the inventory order changes. Two inference requests are submitted. ### Impact and fix direction Replay can evaluate a recording against an arbitrary member of a conflicting model identity, making results order-dependent despite the shared admission contract. Digest pinning protects the choice after selection but does not establish that the alias was unambiguous. Share one validated native-reference resolver across admission and replay, check all equivalent inventory rows before selecting a digest, and retain the replay path's local/non-cloud restrictions. Cover both inventory orders and same-digest duplicate spellings with actual request-count assertions. Duplicate check: searched all issue states for `replay ambiguous` and inspected the issue inventory. Closed issue #93 concerns equivalent-name rejection; this is a distinct surviving replay bypass of the conflict refusal introduced by its follow-up. --- ### GitHub comments (1) > **@coderabbitai[bot]** (2026-11-06T11:02:32Z) > > > > >
